text:
ash: Quick idea 12pm lunch mini-league? 'Lunch Ladder & Pull-up Mini League' 4aa
ash: Rules: 5 workdays, each day you either do a ladder (run stairs or quick hill sprints) OR a pull-up/push session. 1pt per day. bonus point if you beat your previous best. low-key.
riley: love low-key. how strict are we on verification? a timestamped pic or short vid?
azra: (typo) zara: im fine with a short snap or a watch screenshot. keep it low-effort.
marco: can we add a 'most improved' bonus? i get motivated by that.
nash: yeah +1 end-of-week for highest % improvement.
keenan: logistics: lunchtime or post-work? i can only do 12:15-12:45.
janet: same here. lunchtime works. we can have an optional 5pm group if folks want.
ash: poll time: @poll-bot what works?
poll-bot: POLL: "Preferred meetup time for Lunch Ladder & Pull-up Mini League"  Options: "12:15 PM (lunch)", "5:00 PM (after work)", "No meetup (solo)"  Vote now!
riley: voted 12:15.
marco: voted 5pm (i'll try lunchtime too).
keanan: voted "No meetup" (i'll follow solo)
ash: brief how-to for the ladder if you want to join group: do 6-8 hill repeats or stair flights, each 30-45s hard, walk down recovery. total ~12min. for pull-ups: max reps sets OR assisted negatives x 10min.
azra: sample pull-up progression i posted last month: ```
Week1: 3 sets of 5 (assisted)
Week2: 4 sets of 5
Week3: 5 sets of 6
```
riley: added everyone to tiny sheet: https://tinyurl.com/lunch-ladder (column for daily check + improvement pct).
marco: small prize idea: winner gets their lunch paid by the team? cheap coffee voucher?
janet: coffee voucher + a silly digital trophy gif = perfect.
poll-bot: POLL RESULTS: "Preferred meetup time for Lunch Ladder & Pull-up Mini League"  12:15 PM (4 votes), 5:00 PM (2 votes), No meetup (1 vote).
ash: looks like 12:15 is lunch default. optional 5pm sessions for folks who prefer.
keanan: ok i'll log solo then. good luck everyone.
azra: starting Monday?
ash: yep kickoff Monday. post a quick note here when you do a session so people can cheer. :tada: :running_man:
